verdict.rationale: Filee is MIT-licensed open source that builds from source with the .NET 10 SDK on Windows, macOS or Linux, and runs entirely offline on the user's own machine. It also offers silent installs, a portable ZIP and a CLI for scripted use, so the whole core product runs under the user's control with no vendor service involved. Missing for 10: documented headless/server-style deployment for shared or multi-user self-hosting, independent hands-on corroboration of building and running from source.
